description: The project's whole schema: every form, its fields with types and choices, the number of records, and the portals. A link field (rel) names the table it links to (links_to) and how many rows hold a link (rows_linked), and, when there are any, how many links point at no row (links_to_missing_rows) or at a row of another table (links_to_other_table); a linked_column names the field it shows (shows). Call it before create_record, to understand the database, and BEFORE explaining why a table, a link or a linked column shows nothing — the answer is usually in these facts.
name: describe_project
